Kubby Medical Marijuana Case
February 17, 1999

Update Wednesday 7:30 PM

D.A. Cancels Grand Jury Hearing

Deputy District Attorney Christopher Cattran canceled today¹s scheduled Grand Jury hearing. Cattran stated that new evidence has been located on the Kubby¹s computer, but it is unclear whether it helps or hurts the prosecution¹s case.

Joe Farina, one of the Kubby¹s attorneys says this latest reversal in the case by the D.A. is indicative of their weak case and lack of evidence.

Kubby Medical Marijuana Case
February 17, 1999

Update Wednesday 7:30 PM

D.A. Cancels Grand Jury Hearing

Deputy District Attorney Christopher Cattran canceled today¹s scheduled Grand Jury hearing. Cattran stated that new evidence has been located on the Kubby¹s computer, but it is unclear whether it helps or hurts the prosecution¹s case.

Joe Farina, one of the Kubby¹s attorneys says this latest reversal in the case by the D.A. is indicative of their weak case and lack of evidence.

Farina believes the D.A. may still try to convene a Grand Jury, but looks forward to the preliminary hearing on February 22nd at which time he will ask for the return of the Kubby¹s computers, office equipment, passports, books, money and medicine. Another preliminary hearing is set for March 2, 1999.
